title: Casio Unisex Vintage Watch AQ-230EM-7ADF
description:
An updated take on a favorite classic — the ever-popular, easy-to-use A158 goes stylishly elegant with a fine-woven mesh band.
Treated with a specialized pressing process that adds depth and dimension, the mesh band delivers a refined, vintage look and a totally comfortable fit for your wrist. Choose a dial in dark green or light gray. The silver-colored case and contrasting dial present an understated color scheme that adds a simple yet original touch to your style. These classic designs highlight the beauty of metal mesh for a refined and elegant presence all their own.
features: 1/100-second stopwatch Measuring capacity: 59’59.99″ Measuring mode: Elapsed time
Regular timekeeping Analog: 2 hands (Hour, minute) Digital: Hour, minutes, seconds, pm, month, date, day
